```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))

# ── Config ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CLUS_COL <- "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5"   # Seurat cluster column (dot notation)

# Each branch is defined by two parallel vectors:
#   SEQUENCES[[i]]      — cluster IDs that form the trajectory
#   SAMPLE_FILTERS[[i]] — sample.name values to include (NULL = all samples)
SEQUENCES <- list(
  c("5", "1"),
  # c("5", "15", "1"),
  c("2", "15", "1")
)

ALL_SAMPLES <- c("HSC_Het_CD41+mCh-", "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+", "HSC_WT_CD41+")
SAMPLE_FILTERS <- list(
  "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh-",
  # ALL_SAMPLES,
  "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+"
)

SEQ_LABELS <- sapply(SEQUENCES, paste, collapse = " → ")

N_BINS            <- 20     # equal-width intervals in standardised DPT space
N_TOP_GENES       <- 15     # top markers per cluster
MIN_CELLS_PER_BIN <- 1L    # bins with fewer cells than this are dropped
SCALE_METHOD      <- "zscore"  # "zscore" | "minmax"
SCALE_JOINTLY     <- TRUE      # share scale statistics across branches

COND_ORDER <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")
COND_PAL   <- c(WT = "#1f78b4", "mCh-" = "#a6cee3", "mCh+" = "#e31a1c")
ZSCORE_CLIP <- c(-2, 2)    # only applied when SCALE_METHOD == "zscore"

HM_COL <- if (SCALE_METHOD == "zscore") {
  colorRamp2(c(ZSCORE_CLIP[1], 0, ZSCORE_CLIP[2]), c("#2166ac", "white", "#b2182b"))
} else {
  colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "black"))
}
SCALE_NAME <- if (SCALE_METHOD == "zscore") "Z-score" else "Min-max"
```

```{r load-dpt}
                   show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    cell_id = 1,
    dpt     = dpt_pseudotime
  ) %>%

    condition = factor(condition, levels = COND_ORDER)

cat("DPT table:", nrow(dpt_df), "cells\n")
```


```{r load-expr}
tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)

genes_avail <- intersect(top_genes, rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc))
cat("Genes in Seurat:", length(genes_avail), "/", length(top_genes), "\n")

expr_mat  <- GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")[genes_avail, ]

cat("Expression matrix:", nrow(expr_mat), "genes ×", ncol(expr_mat), "cells\n")

# Cluster labels come from Seurat metadata, not the DPT CSV — independent of CLUS_COL

  cell_id = colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc),
  cluster = as.character(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data[[CLUS_COL]])
)

  left_join(cluster_df, by = "cell_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster))

cat("Clusters (", CLUS_COL, "):", paste(sort(unique(dpt_df$cluster)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

---

# 3 · Data functions

Each function performs a single transformation and returns a plain data structure.
No plotting. No global state.

```{r data-functions}
# ── filter_branch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Subset cells belonging to the given cluster sequence and sample set, sorted
# by DPT.
# Input:  dpt_df   (full cell table with sample.name column)
#         seqs     (character vector of cluster IDs)
#         samples  (character vector of sample.name values; NULL = all samples)
# Output: data.frame with columns cell_id, cluster, dpt, condition, sample.name
filter_branch <- function(dpt_df, seqs, samples = NULL) {
  df <- dpt_df %>% filter(cluster %in% seqs)
  if (!is.null(samples)) df <- df %>% filter(sample_name %in% samples)
  df %>% arrange(dpt)
}

# ── standardize_dpt ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Min-max scale DPT to [0, 1] within a branch.
# Input:  branch_df from filter_branch()
# Output: branch_df + std_dpt column
standardize_dpt <- function(branch_df) {
  lo <- min(branch_df$dpt, na.rm = TRUE)
  hi <- max(branch_df$dpt, na.rm = TRUE)
  branch_df %>% mutate(std_dpt = (dpt - lo) / (hi - lo))
}

# ── assign_bins ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Cut std_dpt into n_bins equal-width intervals; collapse empty intervals and
# intervals with fewer than min_cells cells.
# bin_raw: 1..n_bins with gaps where intervals are empty or sparse
# bin:     1..n_occupied (renumbered contiguous surviving intervals)
# Input:  branch_df with std_dpt column (from standardize_dpt)
# Output: branch_df + bin_raw + bin columns (rows in dropped bins are removed)
assign_bins <- function(branch_df, n_bins, min_cells = 1L) {
  branch_df %>%
    arrange(std_dpt) %>%
    mutate(
      bin_raw = as.integer(cut(std_dpt, breaks = n_bins,
                               include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(bin_raw)) %>%
    group_by(bin_raw) %>%
    filter(n() >= min_cells) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      bin = rep(seq_along(rle(bin_raw)$values), rle(bin_raw)$lengths)
    )
}

# ── compute_bin_expr ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Average expression per occupied bin.
# Input:  binned (from assign_bins), expr_mat (genes × cells), genes (character)
# Output: genes × n_occupied dense matrix of mean expression
compute_bin_expr <- function(binned, expr_mat, genes) {
  n_occ   <- max(binned$bin)
  shared  <- intersect(binned$cell_id, colnames(expr_mat))
  bin_vec <- setNames(binned$bin[match(shared, binned$cell_id)], shared)
  sub_mat <- as.matrix(expr_mat[genes, shared, drop = FALSE])

  mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(n_occ), function(b) {
    cols <- names(bin_vec)[bin_vec == b]
    if (!length(cols)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(genes)))
    rowMeans(sub_mat[, cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
  rownames(mat) <- genes
  colnames(mat) <- as.character(seq_len(n_occ))
  mat
}

# ── minmax_rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Min-max scale each gene (row) to [0, 1] across bins.
# lo / hi: optional precomputed per-gene min/max (for joint scaling across branches).
# Input:  genes × bins matrix (from compute_bin_expr)
# Output: genes × bins matrix scaled to [0, 1]
minmax_rows <- function(mat, lo = NULL, hi = NULL) {
  out <- t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) {
    x  <- mat[i, ]
    mn <- if (is.null(lo)) min(x, na.rm = TRUE) else lo[i]
    mx <- if (is.null(hi)) max(x, na.rm = TRUE) else hi[i]
    if (is.na(mx - mn) || mx == mn) return(rep(0, length(x)))
    (x - mn) / (mx - mn)
  }))
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  out
}

# ── zscore_rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Z-score each gene (row) across bins with optional clipping.
# mu / sd_vec: optional precomputed per-gene statistics (length == nrow(mat)).
#   NULL (default) → compute from mat itself (per-branch mode).
#   Providing external mu/sd_vec enables joint scaling across branches.
# clip: length-2 numeric c(lo, hi); use c(-Inf, Inf) to skip clipping.
# Input:  genes × bins matrix (from compute_bin_expr)
# Output: genes × bins matrix of z-scores
zscore_rows <- function(mat, mu = NULL, sd_vec = NULL,
                        clip = c(-Inf, Inf)) {
  out <- t(sapply(seq_len(nrow(mat)), function(i) {
    x <- mat[i, ]
    m <- if (is.null(mu))     mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) else mu[i]
    s <- if (is.null(sd_vec)) sd(x,   na.rm = TRUE) else sd_vec[i]
    z <- if (is.na(s) || s == 0) x - m else (x - m) / s
    pmax(pmin(z, clip[2]), clip[1])
  }))
  rownames(out) <- rownames(mat)
  colnames(out) <- colnames(mat)
  out
}

# ── compute_bin_std_dpt ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Mean standardised DPT per occupied bin (for bottom barplot annotation).
# Input:  binned from assign_bins()
# Output: numeric vector length n_occupied in [0, 1]
compute_bin_std_dpt <- function(binned) {
  n_occ <- max(binned$bin)
  vapply(seq_len(n_occ), function(b) {
    mean(binned$std_dpt[binned$bin == b], na.rm = TRUE)
  }, numeric(1L))
}

# ── compute_bin_cluster ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Dominant (modal) cluster per occupied bin.
# Input:  binned from assign_bins()
# Output: character vector length n_occupied
compute_bin_cluster <- function(binned) {
  n_occ <- max(binned$bin)
  vapply(seq_len(n_occ), function(b) {
    cells_b <- binned$cluster[binned$bin == b]
    tbl <- sort(table(cells_b), decreasing = TRUE)
    names(tbl)[1L]
  }, character(1L))
}

# ── compute_bin_stats ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Cell counts and condition proportions per occupied bin.
# Input:  binned (from assign_bins), cond_order (character vector)
# Output: list(n_cells, cond_prop, n_occupied)
#   n_cells   — integer vector length n_occupied
#   cond_prop — n_occupied × n_conditions matrix of proportions
#   n_occupied — scalar
compute_bin_stats <- function(binned, cond_order) {
  n_occ <- max(binned$bin)

  long <- binned %>%
    count(bin, condition, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(bin) %>%
    mutate(n_total = sum(n), prop = n / n_total) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    complete(bin       = seq_len(n_occ),
             condition = factor(cond_order, levels = cond_order),
             fill      = list(prop = 0, n_total = 0)) %>%
    arrange(bin)

  n_cells <- long %>%
    distinct(bin, n_total) %>%
    arrange(bin) %>%
    pull(n_total)

  cond_prop <- long %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = bin, names_from = condition,
                values_from = prop, values_fill = 0) %>%
    select(all_of(cond_order)) %>%
    as.matrix()

  list(n_cells = n_cells, cond_prop = cond_prop, n_occupied = n_occ)
}
```

# 4 · Plot functions

```{r plot-functions}
# ── plot_dpt_diagnostics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Visualise the three stages of the binning pipeline on the UMAP of branch
# cells, one row per branch, three panels per row:
#   (1) raw DPT   (2) standardised DPT [0, 1]   (3) discrete occupied bins
# Non-branch cells are shown as a grey background for spatial context.
#
# Input:  binned_list — list of data.frames from assign_bins()
#         umap_df     — data.frame with columns cell_id, UMAP1, UMAP2
#         seq_labels  — character vector of branch names
# Output: patchwork (n_branches rows × 3 columns)
plot_dpt_diagnostics <- function(binned_list, umap_df, seq_labels) {
  base_theme <- theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30"),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
      plot.margin     = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )

  rows <- lapply(seq_along(binned_list), function(i) {
    df    <- binned_list[[i]]
    lbl   <- seq_labels[i]
    n_occ <- max(df$bin)
    n_raw <- max(df$bin_raw)

    # join pseudotime values onto UMAP coordinates
    joined <- umap_df %>%
      left_join(select(df, cell_id, dpt, std_dpt, bin), by = "cell_id")
    bg <- filter(joined, is.na(bin))
    fg <- filter(joined, !is.na(bin))

    p1 <- ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = bg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2),
                 colour = "#d8d8d8", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_point(data = fg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = dpt),
                 size = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Raw DPT", option = "plasma") +
      labs(title = "Raw DPT") +
      base_theme

    p2 <- ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = bg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2),
                 colour = "#d8d8d8", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_point(data = fg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = std_dpt),
                 size = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_colour_viridis_c(name = "Std DPT\n[0, 1]", option = "plasma",
                              limits = c(0, 1)) +
      labs(title = "Standardised DPT") +
      base_theme

    cycle_pal <- c("1" = "#e41a1c", "2" = "#377eb8", "3" = "#4daf4a")
    fg_p3     <- fg %>% mutate(bin_cycle = factor(((bin - 1L) %% 3L) + 1L))

    p3 <- ggplot() +
      geom_point(data = bg, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2),
                 colour = "#d8d8d8", size = 0.15, alpha = 0.4) +
      geom_point(data = fg_p3, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = bin_cycle),
                 size = 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = cycle_pal, guide = "none") +
      labs(title = sprintf("Discrete bins (%d/%d)", n_occ, n_raw)) +
      base_theme

    (p1 | p2 | p3) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = lbl,
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10,
                                                 hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)))
      )
  })

  wrap_plots(rows, ncol = 1)
}

# ── make_branch_hm ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Build one ComplexHeatmap panel for a single branch.
# All data is pre-computed. This function only handles layout and rendering.
#
# bin_z      — genes × n_occupied z-score matrix (from zscore_rows)
# bin_stats  — list from compute_bin_stats()
# top_genes  — data.frame with columns $gene and $marker_cluster
# label      — column title string
# row_dend   — shared hclust / dendrogram for consistent gene ordering
# show_row_names — show gene labels (right side; TRUE on last panel)
# show_row_annot — show Cluster colour sidebar (TRUE on first panel)
# show_legend    — show Z-score legend (TRUE on first panel)
make_branch_hm <- function(bin_z, bin_stats, bin_cluster, bin_std_dpt,
                            top_genes, label,
                            cond_pal, cond_order, hm_col, clust_pal,
                            scale_name  = "Z-score",
                            show_legend = FALSE) {

  n_cells   <- bin_stats$n_cells
  cond_prop <- bin_stats$cond_prop

  ha_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Cluster = bin_cluster,
    col     = list(Cluster = clust_pal[sort(unique(bin_cluster))]),
    show_legend          = show_legend,
    simple_anno_size     = unit(4, "mm"),
    `n cells` = anno_barplot(
      n_cells,
      gp         = gpar(fill = "grey35", col = NA),
      height     = unit(1.8, "cm"),
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 6))
    ),
    Condition = anno_barplot(
      cond_prop,
      gp         = gpar(fill = cond_pal[cond_order], col = NA),
      height     = unit(4, "mm"),
      bar_width  = 1,
      axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 6))
    ),
    annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    annotation_name_side = "left"
  )

  bot_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    `Std DPT` = bin_std_dpt,
    col       = list(`Std DPT` = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1),
                                             c("#440154", "#21908c", "#fde725"))),
    show_legend          = show_legend,
    simple_anno_size     = unit(4, "mm"),
    annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    annotation_name_side = "left"
  )

  Heatmap(
    bin_z,
    name                = scale_name,
    col                 = hm_col,
    cluster_columns     = FALSE,
    cluster_rows        = FALSE,
    show_row_dend       = FALSE,
    show_row_names      = TRUE,
    row_names_side      = "right",
    row_names_gp        = gpar(fontsize = 10),
    show_column_names   = TRUE,
    column_names_rot    = 90,
    column_names_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 5),
    column_title        = label,
    column_title_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    top_annotation      = ha_top,
    bottom_annotation   = bot_ha,
    show_heatmap_legend = show_legend,
    border              = TRUE,
    use_raster          = FALSE
  )
}
```

---

# 5 · Process branches

Each transformation step is run independently and stored so intermediate results
are accessible for inspection or re-use.

```{r process-branches}
genes <- top_genes

# Step 1 — filter: cells belonging to each branch (cluster sequence × sample set)
branch_list <- lapply(seq_along(SEQUENCES), function(i) {
  filter_branch(dpt_df, SEQUENCES[[i]], SAMPLE_FILTERS[[i]])
})
names(branch_list) <- SEQ_LABELS

# Step 2 — standardise DPT to [0, 1] per branch
branch_std_list <- lapply(branch_list, standardize_dpt)

# Step 3 — assign discrete bins (collapse empty / sparse intervals)
binned_list <- lapply(branch_std_list, assign_bins,
                      n_bins = N_BINS, min_cells = MIN_CELLS_PER_BIN)

# Step 4 — mean expression per bin
bin_expr_list <- lapply(binned_list, compute_bin_expr,
                        expr_mat = expr_mat, genes = genes)

# Step 5 — scale across bins per gene (SCALE_METHOD: "zscore" | "minmax")
if (SCALE_METHOD == "zscore") {
  if (SCALE_JOINTLY) {
    pool    <- do.call(cbind, bin_expr_list)
    jt_mu   <- rowMeans(pool, na.rm = TRUE)
    jt_sd   <- apply(pool, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
    bin_z_list <- lapply(bin_expr_list, zscore_rows,
                         mu = jt_mu, sd_vec = jt_sd, clip = ZSCORE_CLIP)
  } else {
    bin_z_list <- lapply(bin_expr_list, zscore_rows, clip = ZSCORE_CLIP)
  }
} else {
  if (SCALE_JOINTLY) {
    pool   <- do.call(cbind, bin_expr_list)
    jt_lo  <- apply(pool, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)
    jt_hi  <- apply(pool, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
    bin_z_list <- lapply(bin_expr_list, minmax_rows, lo = jt_lo, hi = jt_hi)
  } else {
    bin_z_list <- lapply(bin_expr_list, minmax_rows)
  }
}

# Step 6 — per-bin cell counts and condition proportions
bin_stats_list <- lapply(binned_list, compute_bin_stats, cond_order = COND_ORDER)

# Step 7 — dominant cluster per occupied bin (for top annotation colour bar)
bin_cluster_list <- lapply(binned_list, compute_bin_cluster)

# Step 8 — mean std_dpt per occupied bin (for bottom barplot annotation)
bin_std_dpt_list <- lapply(binned_list, compute_bin_std_dpt)

# Summary report
for (i in seq_along(SEQUENCES)) {
  s <- bin_stats_list[[i]]
  cat(sprintf(
    "%s: %d cells  |  %d / %d bins occupied  |  cells/bin [%d, %d]\n",
    SEQ_LABELS[i], sum(s$n_cells),
    s$n_occupied, N_BINS,
    min(s$n_cells), max(s$n_cells)
  ))
}
```

---

# 6 · Binning diagnostics

Each row is one branch. The three UMAP panels show:

1. **Raw DPT** — original pseudotime values from DPT; cells near the root
   cluster at low values, late-trajectory cells are sparse at high values.
2. **Standardised DPT [0, 1]** — per-branch min-max normalisation; the colour
   scale now spans the full trajectory regardless of absolute DPT magnitude.
3. **Discrete bins** — the `r N_BINS` equal-width intervals after collapsing
   empty ones; each colour is one occupied bin, showing how bins map to UMAP
   space.

Non-branch cells shown in grey for spatial context.

```{r dpt-diagnostics, fig.width=13, fig.height=13}
plot_dpt_diagnostics(binned_list, umap_df, SEQ_LABELS)
```

---

# 7 · Expression heatmaps

Each column = one occupied bin (same width in standardised pseudotime space).
Column height in the *n cells* bar varies — tall = many cells at that stage.
Rows are genes clustered by the shared dendrogram from branch `r SEQ_LABELS[1]`.

```{r heatmaps, fig.width=20, fig.height=13}
n_seq   <- length(SEQUENCES)
hm_list <- lapply(seq_along(SEQUENCES), function(i) {
  make_branch_hm(
    bin_z        = bin_z_list[[i]],
    bin_stats    = bin_stats_list[[i]],
    bin_cluster  = bin_cluster_list[[i]],
    bin_std_dpt  = bin_std_dpt_list[[i]],
    top_genes    = top_genes,
    label        = SEQ_LABELS[i],
    scale_name   = SCALE_NAME,
    cond_pal     = COND_PAL,
    cond_order   = COND_ORDER,
    hm_col       = HM_COL,
    clust_pal   = clust_pal,
    show_legend = (i == 1L)
  )
})

draw(
  Reduce("+", hm_list),
  column_title     = "DPT trajectory — binned gene expression",
  column_title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
  merge_legends    = TRUE,
  padding          = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm")
)
```

# 8 · Per-sequence cell counts

```{r summary-tables, results="asis"}
for (i in seq_along(SEQUENCES)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## Sequence %d: %s\n\n", i, SEQ_LABELS[i]))
  s   <- bin_stats_list[[i]]
  tbl <- tibble(
    Bin       = seq_along(s$n_cells),
    `n cells` = s$n_cells
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(s$cond_prop)) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(COND_ORDER), ~ scales::percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1)))

  print(knitr::kable(tbl, caption = SEQ_LABELS[i]))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
